gui.guhs.safari.infobord.leeuw: Lions sleep up to 20 hours a day. Nice and chonky. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.luipaard: A leopard drags its food up a tree, so nobody steals it. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.olifant: Elephants recognise each other after years. They never forget a cuddle. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.neushoorn: A rhino horn is made of the same stuff as your nails. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kafferbuffel: Buffalo vote together which way the herd goes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.dikdik: A dik-dik is only as big as a chonky cat. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.giraffe: A giraffe's tongue is bluish and up to 45 cm long. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zebra: No two zebras have the same stripes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.stokstaartje: Meerkats take turns keeping watch. Always upright! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.jachtluipaard: The cheetah is the fastest land animal, but super sleepy after a sprint. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.struisvogel: An ostrich egg is as big as 24 chicken eggs. Giant omelette! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeekoe: Manatees are related to... elephants! You can tell by the chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.nijlpaard: Hippos can't swim: they walk along the bottom. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.flamingo: Flamingos are pink because of what they eat. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.capibara: Capybaras are friends with everyone. Really everyone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.krokodil: A crocodile can stay under water for an hour, and smile at the same time. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.rode_panda: Red pandas use their fluffy tail as a blanket. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.reuzenpanda: A giant panda eats bamboo for about 12 hours a day. Vahoeg. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gibbon: Gibbons sing a duet together in the morning. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.luiaard: Sloths only come down once a week to go to the toilet. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.okapi: The okapi looks like a zebra, but is related to the giraffe. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.orang_oetan: Orangutans build a new bed of leaves every evening. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.toekan: A toucan's beak is big, but very light. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gekko: Geckos walk up walls thanks to tiny hairs on their toes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.glimworm: Glow-worms make their tail glow to lure snacks. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pinguin: Emperor penguins cuddle together against the cold: the huddle! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ijsbeer: A polar bear has black skin under its white fur. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeehond: Seals can sleep under water, with their nose shut. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.narwal: A narwhal's tusk can grow up to 3 metres long. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.octopus: An octopus has three hearts. Triple sweet! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.sabeltandtijger: Sabre-tooth tigers lived in the ice age. Luckily this one is sweet. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mammoet: A mammoth had thick fur and a layer of fat: extra chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wolharige_neush: The woolly rhino pushed snow aside with its horn. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.bever: Beavers have orange teeth: there's iron in them. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.vuursalamander: Fire salamanders love rain and wet stones. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.egel: A hedgehog has about 5000 spines. No cuddles without a glove. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.otter: Otters hold paws when they sleep, so they don't drift apart. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.das: A badger sett can be hundreds of years old. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.edelhert: A red deer grows new antlers every year. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ooievaar: Storks clatter their beak to say hello. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.specht: A woodpecker taps up to 20 times a second. Tok tok tok! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.koala: Koalas sleep up to 22 hours a day. Even chonkier than a lion. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kangoeroe: A baby kangaroo is as big as a bean when it's born. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wombat: Wombats make square droppings. Yes, really. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.quokka: The quokka is called the happiest animal in the world. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.prieelvogel: A male bowerbird decorates his bower with blue things. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gouden_dikdik: A golden dik-dik? That doesn't exist. Except this one. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.geitje: Little goats climb on everything, even on other little goats. The higher, the chonkier. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.alpaca: An alpaca only spits when it's really cross. Mostly it's just very fluffy. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.cavia: Happy guinea pigs do little jumps in the air. That's called 'popcorning'! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.ezeltje: Little donkeys remember places and friends for a very long time, sometimes 25 years. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kameleon: A chameleon can look two ways at once with its little eyes. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.reuzenschildpad: Giant tortoises can live past 150. Slow and steady, chonk. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.slang: A snake smells with its tongue. That's why it keeps sticking it out. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.hoornkikker: A horned frog is almost all mouth. Chomp! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kraaghagedis: When a frilled lizard gets a fright, it opens its frill and runs off on two legs. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.gifkikker: Poison dart frogs are so brightly coloured to say: don't eat me! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.baardagaam: A bearded dragon waves its little paw to say hello. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mier: An ant can lift 50 times its own weight. So strong! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.springspin: A jumping spider has eight eyes and jumps 50 times its own length. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.wandelende_tak: A stick insect sways to and fro, just like a twig in the wind. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.mestkever: A dung beetle navigates by the stars. Yes, by the Milky Way! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.slak: A snail has thousands of tiny teeth. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.vogelspin: A tarantula is fluffy like a plushie, but it doesn't like cuddles. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.hommel: A bumblebee buzzes so loud because it shivers its wings warm. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kiwi: A kiwi is the only bird with nostrils at the tip of its beak. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.schubdier: A pangolin rolls into a ball when it's scared. A living pine cone! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.spookdiertje: Each eye of a tarsier is bigger than its brain. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.plompe_lori: The slow loris does everything very, very, very slowly. Chonk to the bone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.fruitvleermuis: Fruit bats sleep upside down, wrapped in their wings like a blanket. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.galago: A bushbaby jumps up to two metres high. Boing! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.suikereekhoorn: A sugar glider glides from tree to tree with a skin flap between its legs. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.fennek: With its giant ears a fennec fox can even hear a beetle walking under the sand. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeepaardje: With seahorses, the dad has the babies. Nice for mum! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pijlstaartrog: A stingray 'flies' under water with its big fins. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeeschildpad: Sea turtles swim thousands of kilometres and always find their way back to their beach. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.clownvis: A clownfish lives safely among the stinging arms of an anemone. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.anemoon: An anemone looks like a flower, but it's an animal! The clownfish lives safely in between. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kwal: Jellyfish have no brain, no heart and no bones. Very pretty though. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.kogelvis: A pufferfish puffs up into a spiky ball when it's startled. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zeester: A starfish can grow back an arm. And the sea urchins are its best friends. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.zee_egel: A sea urchin walks on hundreds of tiny feet, very slowly across the bottom. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.babyhaai: Sharks have rows of teeth: when one falls out, the next one moves forward. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.regenboogvis: Rainbowfish swim in a school: together they turn like one big fish. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.lantaarnvisje: A lanternfish makes its own light, deep in the dark sea. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.dumbo_octopus: The Dumbo octopus flaps its little ears, just like the elephant from the film. Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.pelikaan: A pelican's throat pouch holds more than its stomach. Gobble! Look around carefully, maybe you'll spot one!
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.algemeen: Living here: %s! A real resident of the park. Don't tap on the glass, they don't find that chonky at all.
gui.guhs.safari.infobord.leeg: This board is still waiting for an animal. It's standing here very patiently, nyeg.
